questions.question: Which landlocked country is bordered by Switzerland to the west and north, and Italy to the east and south?
questions.fun_fact: Liechtenstein is doubly landlocked, meaning it is surrounded entirely by countries that are also landlocked.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for the metallic element gold?
questions.fun_fact: The symbol Au comes from 'aurum', the Latin word for gold, which translates to 'shining dawn'.

questions.question: The ancient city of Carthage was located in the territory of which modern-day North African country?
questions.fun_fact: The ruins of Carthage lie just outside the modern city of Tunis, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.question: Which 1994 animated musical drama film features the song 'Circle of Life' composed by Elton John?
questions.fun_fact: The Lion King was Disney's first animated feature to be based on an original story rather than a pre-existing literary work.

questions.question: Tempeh is a traditional soy product originating from which Southeast Asian country?
questions.fun_fact: Tempeh is made by a natural culturing and controlled fermentation process that binds soybeans into a compact cake.

questions.question: What is the only mammal capable of sustained powered flight?
questions.fun_fact: Bats make up about one-fifth of all classified mammal species worldwide.

questions.question: In the sport of American football, how many points is a touchdown worth before any extra point or two-point conversion attempt?
questions.fun_fact: A touchdown was originally worth zero points in the very first American football game in 1869, where teams scored solely by kicking the ball through the goalposts.

questions.question: What linguistic term is used for a word that is spelled the same way forwards and backwards?
questions.fun_fact: The longest single-word palindrome in standard English dictionaries is 'tattarrattat', coined by James Joyce in Ulysses for a knock on a door.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system has the most extensive and complex ring system composed mostly of ice particles and rocky debris?
questions.fun_fact: Although Saturn has the most prominent rings, all four gas and ice giant planets in our solar system possess ring systems.

questions.question: The Code of Hammurabi, one of the oldest deciphered writings of significant length in the world, originated from which ancient civilization?
questions.fun_fact: The laws of Hammurabi were inscribed on a large basalt stele and famously established the principle of 'an eye for an eye'.
